paper.title_en: The devil in the transition: NLO nucleation and the particle physics behind the PTA signal
paper.abstract_en: We quantify how the treatment of a strongly supercooled phase transition affects the particle-physics interpretation of a nanohertz gravitational-wave signal. For the classically conformal Abelian Higgs model, we calculate the nucleation rate at NLO in the dimensionally reduced theory and test the gradient expansion against explicit fluctuation determinants. A calibrated correction reproduces the determinant exponent with a mean absolute relative difference of $0.8\%$ and allows this information to be included throughout the parameter scan. We propagate the corrected rate through percolation, reheating and gravitational-wave production, and confront the resulting spectra with the NANOGrav 15-year and IPTA DR2 data. The corrected NLO calculation shifts the preferred gauge coupling by $9\%$ and $13\%$, respectively, and the input scale by $18\%$ for NANOGrav. After the determinant calibration, the largest theoretical uncertainties arise from uncertainties in the gravitational-wave spectra and the relation between $R_\star$ and $β/H$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将强过冷相变的核化率计算推广到NLO，并把结果传播到渗流、重加热与引力波谱，直接与NANOGrav 15年和IPTA DR2数据比较，给出规范耦合与输入标度的定量偏移。理论推导（维度约化、梯度展开检验、行列式标定）与观测对照结合紧密，对PTA信号粒子物理解释具有明确参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 过渡中的魔鬼：NLO核化率与PTA信号背后的粒子物理
decision.abstract_zh: 我们量化了强过冷相变的处理方式如何影响对纳赫兹引力波信号的粒子物理解释。对于经典共形阿贝尔希格斯模型，我们在维度约化理论中计算了NLO阶的核化率，并用显式涨落行列式检验了梯度展开。一个经过标定的修正以0.8%的平均绝对相对差异复现行列式指数，并允许该信息贯穿整个参数扫描。我们将修正后的核化率传播通过渗流、重加热与引力波产生过程，并将所得谱与NANOGrav 15年数据和IPTA DR2数据进行对照。修正后的NLO计算分别使偏好规范耦合移动了9%和13%，对NANOGrav而言使输入标度移动了18%。经过行列式标定后，最大的理论不确定性来自引力波谱的不确定性以及$R_\star$与$β/H$之间的关系。
